description: Equipements d’accessibilité en gare is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Liste des équipements d’accessibilité recensés dans les gares SNCF pour améliorer l’accessibilité des clients. Cette liste est mise à jour au fur et à mesure. Ces informations ne sont donc pas encore disponibles pour toutes les gares. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Equipements et services en gares, Gares. Its keywords are Gares, Accessibilité, Equipement. The portal shows 2026-08-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
